summary: Tested Model Grouping feature for sauna calculator. All 7 backend tests passed. Frontend tests confirmed all features working correctly: (1) Backend accepts modelGroup and modelGroupImageUrl fields, (2) Admin Edit/Add Model dialogs have 'Группа модели' input with datalist autocomplete, (3) Calculator shows flat list when no groups set, (4) Calculator shows group cards when models have modelGroup, (5) Clicking group shows sub-models with back button, (6) Back button returns to groups view.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set modelGroup='TEST_Квадро-Бочка' on 2 models to test grouping (cleaned up after test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Model Grouping feature fully implemented and tested. Key test IDs: data-testid='model-groups-grid' (groups container), data-testid='model-group-{groupName}' (group card), data-testid='back-to-groups-btn' (back button), data-testid='model-submodels-grid' (sub-models container), data-testid='model-card-{id}' (individual model card). Currently NO models have modelGroup set in production data, so calculator shows flat list. To enable grouping, set modelGroup field on models via Admin Cennik -> Edit Model dialog.

features_tested.admin_group_field_helper_text: PASS - Helper text: 'Модели с одинаковой группой будут объединены в калькуляторе'
